degenerate_armour_plate.name: Degenerate Armour Plate
degenerate_armour_plate.current_text: Neutronium held at stellar-core pressure by a spacetime-alloy frame. Starlight does not dent it.
degenerate_armour_plate.research: Compact Stars - Neutron stars, magnetars, pulsars and quark stars - the densest objects short of a singularity.

pentaquark_shard.name: Pentaquark Shard
pentaquark_shard.current_text: Five quarks bound into one exotic hadron. They only exist for an instant - unless you crystallise them.
pentaquark_shard.research: Accelerator Physics - Bend a beam with dipoles, focus it with quadrupoles, push it with RF cavities - and keep it all at two kelvin in a perfect vacuum. Unlocks the beamline components and the Hyperion Synchrotron.

glueball_core.name: Glueball Core
glueball_core.current_text: A particle made of nothing but the force carriers that hold quarks together.
glueball_core.research: Accelerator Physics - Bend a beam with dipoles, focus it with quadrupoles, push it with RF cavities - and keep it all at two kelvin in a perfect vacuum. Unlocks the beamline components and the Hyperion Synchrotron.

hyperon_crystal.name: Hyperon Crystal
hyperon_crystal.current_text: Strange baryons locked into a lattice. The strangeness makes them heavier than they have any right to be.
hyperon_crystal.research: Accelerator Physics - Bend a beam with dipoles, focus it with quadrupoles, push it with RF cavities - and keep it all at two kelvin in a perfect vacuum. Unlocks the beamline components and the Hyperion Synchrotron.

hypernova_alloy_ingot.name: Hypernova Alloy Ingot
hypernova_alloy_ingot.current_text: Forged in a plasma hotter than a collapsing star. Still glowing, and always will be.
hypernova_alloy_ingot.research: Stellar Transcendence - Above stellar-core temperatures, matter stops having fixed properties. Unlocks the Transcendent Plasma Forge.

transcendent_metal_ingot.name: Transcendent Metal Ingot
transcendent_metal_ingot.current_text: A metal whose properties are set by the forge, not by physics.
transcendent_metal_ingot.research: Stellar Transcendence - Above stellar-core temperatures, matter stops having fixed properties. Unlocks the Transcendent Plasma Forge.

horizon_shard.name: Horizon Shard
horizon_shard.current_text: A sliver of event horizon brought back out of a simulated universe. Everything that falls into it is remembered.
horizon_shard.research: Horizon Simulation - A black hole is the densest possible computer. Feed it a star and it will simulate one. Unlocks the Eye of the Event Horizon.

natural_number_lattice.name: Natural Number Lattice
natural_number_lattice.current_text: One, two, three... Peano built all of arithmetic from zero and "the next one".
natural_number_lattice.research: The Platonic Realm - If mathematical objects exist somewhere, they exist here. Unlocks the Platonic Compass.

integer_ring.name: Integer Ring
integer_ring.current_text: The naturals, plus their antimatter reflections: every number now has a negative.
integer_ring.research: Number Systems - Zero, and "the next one". From two rules, all of arithmetic. Unlocks the Peano Arithmetic Engine.

rational_field.name: Rational Field
rational_field.current_text: Every ratio of integers. Dense everywhere - and still full of holes.
rational_field.research: Number Systems - Zero, and "the next one". From two rules, all of arithmetic. Unlocks the Peano Arithmetic Engine.

real_continuum.name: Real Continuum
real_continuum.current_text: The rationals with every gap filled - including the transcendental numbers mined from the Platonic Realm.
real_continuum.research: Real Analysis - Limits, continuity and the completion of the rationals into the reals. Unlocks the Analytic Continuator.

imaginary_unit.name: Imaginary Unit
imaginary_unit.current_text: The square root of minus one, distilled from the imaginary mass of a tachyon.
imaginary_unit.research: Complex Analysis - Add the square root of minus one and every polynomial has its roots. Fourier series and fractals follow.

complex_plane.name: Complex Plane
complex_plane.current_text: Real and imaginary at right angles. Every polynomial finally has its roots.
complex_plane.research: Complex Analysis - Add the square root of minus one and every polynomial has its roots. Fourier series and fractals follow.

quaternion_crystal.name: Quaternion Crystal
quaternion_crystal.current_text: Hamilton carved i² = j² = k² = ijk = -1 into a bridge. Here it is carved into a crystal: pure rotation.
quaternion_crystal.research: Abstract Algebra - Quaternions, octonions and spinors: number systems that give up commutativity, then associativity.

octonion_crystal.name: Octonion Crystal
octonion_crystal.current_text: Eight dimensions, and multiplication no longer associates. The largest number system that still divides.
octonion_crystal.research: Abstract Algebra - Quaternions, octonions and spinors: number systems that give up commutativity, then associativity.

surreal_number.name: Surreal Number
surreal_number.current_text: Conway's numbers: every real, every ordinal, every infinitesimal - all in one ordered field.
surreal_number.research: Transfinite Mathematics - Cantor proved that some infinities are bigger than others. Build them. Unlocks the Cantor Diagonalizer.

prime_shard.name: Prime Shard
prime_shard.current_text: Divisible only by itself and one. Grows naturally in the Platonic Realm; otherwise it has to be sieved out.
prime_shard.research: Number Theory - Primes, modular forms and the Riemann zeta function - the hardest problems in mathematics are about whole numbers.

modular_form.name: Modular Form
modular_form.current_text: A function so symmetric it is called "the fifth fundamental operation of arithmetic".
modular_form.research: Number Theory - Primes, modular forms and the Riemann zeta function - the hardest problems in mathematics are about whole numbers.

riemann_zeta_crystal.name: Riemann Zeta Crystal
riemann_zeta_crystal.current_text: Every non-trivial zero lies on the critical line. Probably. This crystal grew along it.
riemann_zeta_crystal.research: Number Theory - Primes, modular forms and the Riemann zeta function - the hardest problems in mathematics are about whole numbers.

transcendental_crystal.name: Transcendental Crystal
transcendental_crystal.current_text: π and e, which no polynomial can reach. Only found in the Platonic Realm.

infinitesimal.name: Infinitesimal
infinitesimal.current_text: Smaller than every positive number, yet not zero.
infinitesimal.research: Real Analysis - Limits, continuity and the completion of the rationals into the reals. Unlocks the Analytic Continuator.

function_graph.name: Function Graph
function_graph.current_text: A rule that sends every input to exactly one output - drawn as a curve of light.
function_graph.research: Real Analysis - Limits, continuity and the completion of the rationals into the reals. Unlocks the Analytic Continuator.

derivative_operator.name: Derivative Operator
derivative_operator.current_text: Instantaneous rate of change: the slope of a curve at a single point.
derivative_operator.research: Calculus - Infinitesimals, derivatives and integrals - and manifolds, the spaces calculus lives on.

integral_operator.name: Integral Operator
integral_operator.current_text: The area under a curve, summed from infinitely many infinitesimal slices.
integral_operator.research: Calculus - Infinitesimals, derivatives and integrals - and manifolds, the spaces calculus lives on.

fourier_series.name: Fourier Series
fourier_series.current_text: Any signal is a sum of waves. This one is a sum of all of them.
fourier_series.research: Complex Analysis - Add the square root of minus one and every polynomial has its roots. Fourier series and fractals follow.

fractal_set.name: Fractal Set
fractal_set.current_text: z → z² + c, iterated forever. Infinitely detailed at every scale.
fractal_set.research: Complex Analysis - Add the square root of minus one and every polynomial has its roots. Fourier series and fractals follow.

fractal_dust.name: Fractal Dust
fractal_dust.current_text: Self-similar grit from the Platonic Realm. Every grain contains smaller copies of the whole pile.
fractal_dust.research: The Platonic Realm - If mathematical objects exist somewhere, they exist here. Unlocks the Platonic Compass.

differential_manifold.name: Differential Manifold
differential_manifold.current_text: A space that is flat up close and curved far away - the stage on which relativity is written.
differential_manifold.research: Calculus - Infinitesimals, derivatives and integrals - and manifolds, the spaces calculus lives on.

mobius_strip.name: Möbius Strip
mobius_strip.current_text: One side, one edge. Walk along it and you come back upside down.
mobius_strip.research: Geometric Topology - Surfaces with one side and bottles with no inside.

klein_bottle.name: Klein Bottle
klein_bottle.current_text: A bottle with no inside. It only fits together in four dimensions.
klein_bottle.research: Geometric Topology - Surfaces with one side and bottles with no inside.

axiom_schema.name: Axiom Schema
axiom_schema.current_text: The rules you agree to before you prove anything.
axiom_schema.research: Formal Logic - Axioms, inference rules, proofs. Unlocks the Formal Proof Assistant and the Empty Set.

empty_set.name: Empty Set
empty_set.current_text: The set with nothing in it - made from the nothing a Void Wraith leaves behind.
empty_set.research: Formal Logic - Axioms, inference rules, proofs. Unlocks the Formal Proof Assistant and the Empty Set.

power_set.name: Power Set
power_set.current_text: The set of all subsets. Always strictly bigger than what you started with.
power_set.research: Set Theory - Everything is a set. Power sets, the continuum, and the axiom of choice.

formal_proof_tree.name: Formal Proof Tree
formal_proof_tree.current_text: Every step justified, every axiom cited. Machines can check it; humans rarely can.
formal_proof_tree.research: Formal Logic - Axioms, inference rules, proofs. Unlocks the Formal Proof Assistant and the Empty Set.

continuum_shard.name: Continuum Shard
continuum_shard.current_text: The cardinality of the real line. Is it the next infinity after aleph-null? The axioms cannot say.
continuum_shard.research: Transfinite Mathematics - Cantor proved that some infinities are bigger than others. Build them. Unlocks the Cantor Diagonalizer.

axiom_of_choice.name: Axiom of Choice
axiom_of_choice.current_text: From every set of sets you may pick one of each. Accept it and spheres can be doubled.
axiom_of_choice.research: Set Theory - Everything is a set. Power sets, the continuum, and the axiom of choice.

category_lattice.name: Category Lattice
category_lattice.current_text: Objects and arrows, and nothing else. All of mathematics fits inside.
category_lattice.research: Category Theory - Objects and arrows. Functors between categories, and toposes - universes with their own logic.

functor_bridge.name: Functor Bridge
functor_bridge.current_text: A map between categories that keeps every arrow pointing the right way.
functor_bridge.research: Category Theory - Objects and arrows. Functors between categories, and toposes - universes with their own logic.

topos.name: Topos
topos.current_text: A universe of mathematics with its own internal logic. Change the topos and you change what is true.
topos.research: Category Theory - Objects and arrows. Functors between categories, and toposes - universes with their own logic.

up_down_quarks.name: Up & Down Quarks
up_down_quarks.current_text: The two lightest quark flavours - everything you have ever touched is made of them.
up_down_quarks.research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

strange_charm_quarks.name: Strange & Charm Quarks
strange_charm_quarks.current_text: The second generation: heavier, and they only exist for an instant outside strange matter.
strange_charm_quarks.research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

bottom_top_quarks.name: Bottom & Top Quarks
bottom_top_quarks.current_text: The third generation. The top quark weighs as much as a gold atom and decays before it can bind to anything.
bottom_top_quarks.research: The Standard Model - Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

lepton_triplet.name: Lepton Triplet
lepton_triplet.current_text: Electron, muon and tau - with a neutrino shadowing each.
lepton_triplet.research: The Standard Model - Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

gauge_boson_cluster.name: Gauge Boson Cluster
gauge_boson_cluster.current_text: Photon, gluon, W and Z: the carriers of every force except gravity.
gauge_boson_cluster.research: The Standard Model - Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

higgs_boson_crystal.name: Higgs Boson Crystal
higgs_boson_crystal.current_text: An excitation of the field that gives everything its mass, frozen before it could decay.
higgs_boson_crystal.research: The Standard Model - Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

standard_model_matrix.name: Standard Model Matrix
standard_model_matrix.current_text: Every known particle in one lattice. It explains almost everything - except gravity and dark matter.
standard_model_matrix.research: The Standard Model - Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

superpartner_shard.name: Superpartner Shard
superpartner_shard.current_text: A neutralino: the supersymmetric twin of a boson. It turns out to be what dark matter is made of.
superpartner_shard.research: Supersymmetry - Every boson has a fermion twin. The lightest of them is dark matter.

grand_unified_core.name: Grand Unified Core
grand_unified_core.current_text: At high enough energy the strong, weak and electromagnetic forces are one force again.
grand_unified_core.research: Grand Unification - At high enough energy, three forces become one.

lorentz_transform_crystal.name: Lorentz Transform Crystal
lorentz_transform_crystal.current_text: Lengths shrink and clocks slow as you approach light speed. This crystal is always moving at 0.99c.
lorentz_transform_crystal.research: Special Relativity - The speed of light is the same for everyone - so time and space cannot be. Unlocks the Tensor Calculus Engine.

minkowski_lattice.name: Minkowski Lattice
minkowski_lattice.current_text: Space and time as one four-dimensional geometry, with light cones at every point.
minkowski_lattice.research: Special Relativity - The speed of light is the same for everyone - so time and space cannot be. Unlocks the Tensor Calculus Engine.

metric_tensor.name: Metric Tensor
metric_tensor.current_text: g_μν: the rule for measuring distance in curved spacetime.
metric_tensor.research: General Relativity - Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

riemann_curvature_tensor.name: Riemann Curvature Tensor
riemann_curvature_tensor.current_text: How much a vector turns when carried around a small loop - curvature itself.
riemann_curvature_tensor.research: General Relativity - Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

einstein_field_core.name: Einstein Field Core
einstein_field_core.current_text: Matter tells spacetime how to curve; spacetime tells matter how to move. Both halves, in one core.
einstein_field_core.research: General Relativity - Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

gravitational_wave_crystal.name: Gravitational Wave Crystal
gravitational_wave_crystal.current_text: A ripple in spacetime from two merging black holes, caught and frozen mid-oscillation.
gravitational_wave_crystal.research: General Relativity - Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

kerr_metric_shard.name: Kerr Metric Shard
kerr_metric_shard.current_text: The exact geometry around a spinning black hole - ergosphere and all.
kerr_metric_shard.research: General Relativity - Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

protostar_core.name: Protostar Core
protostar_core.current_text: A collapsing knot of nebular gas, hot enough to glow but not yet to fuse.
protostar_core.research: Stellar Evolution - Stars are born from nebulae, live on the main sequence, swell into giants and die. Unlocks the Nucleosynthesis Chamber.

red_giant_envelope.name: Red Giant Envelope
red_giant_envelope.current_text: The swollen outer layers of a dying star, a hundred times wider than it once was.
red_giant_envelope.research: Stellar Evolution - Stars are born from nebulae, live on the main sequence, swell into giants and die. Unlocks the Nucleosynthesis Chamber.

white_dwarf_core.name: White Dwarf Core
white_dwarf_core.current_text: A star's carbon heart, the size of a planet and held up only by electron degeneracy.
white_dwarf_core.research: Stellar Evolution - Stars are born from nebulae, live on the main sequence, swell into giants and die. Unlocks the Nucleosynthesis Chamber.

stellar_iron_ingot.name: Stellar Iron Ingot
stellar_iron_ingot.current_text: Iron from the core of a star - the end of fusion. Making anything heavier costs energy instead of releasing it.
stellar_iron_ingot.research: Nucleosynthesis - Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.

supernova_remnant.name: Supernova Remnant
supernova_remnant.current_text: What is left after a star's core collapses and its outer layers are blasted across the galaxy.
supernova_remnant.research: Nucleosynthesis - Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.

r_process_cluster.name: R-Process Cluster
r_process_cluster.current_text: Gold, platinum and uranium, forged in seconds by the neutron flood of a supernova.
r_process_cluster.research: Nucleosynthesis - Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.

kaluza_klein_shard.name: Kaluza-Klein Shard
kaluza_klein_shard.current_text: Momentum around a fifth dimension curled up too small to see. Mined in the Bulk.
kaluza_klein_shard.research: Brane Cosmology - Our universe is a membrane floating in the Bulk. The Brane Shifter can take you there.

dilaton_crystal.name: Dilaton Crystal
dilaton_crystal.current_text: A frozen value of the string coupling - how strongly strings interact. Grows on the Graviton Reefs of the Bulk.

moduli_crystal.name: Moduli Crystal
moduli_crystal.current_text: The shape and size of the hidden dimensions, crystallised. Found in the Moduli Wastes of the Bulk.

brane_tension_fiber.name: Brane Tension Fiber
brane_tension_fiber.current_text: A thread pulled from the membrane a Brane Strider walks on.

graviton_wisp_core.name: Graviton Wisp Core
graviton_wisp_core.current_text: The heart of a Graviton Wisp: a closed loop of gravity that still pulls on your hand.

compactified_circle.name: Compactified Circle
compactified_circle.current_text: A whole dimension rolled up into a circle smaller than a Planck length.
compactified_circle.research: Compactification - Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.

string_coupling_crystal.name: String Coupling Crystal
string_coupling_crystal.current_text: Tunes how strongly strings split and join. Turn it up and string theory becomes a different string theory.
string_coupling_crystal.research: Compactification - Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.

d_brane_sheet.name: D-Brane Sheet
d_brane_sheet.current_text: The surface where open strings end. Our universe might be one.
d_brane_sheet.research: Compactification - Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.

g2_manifold.name: G₂ Manifold
g2_manifold.current_text: Seven curled-up dimensions whose symmetry is the automorphism group of the octonions.
g2_manifold.research: Compactification - Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.

m_theory_core.name: M-Theory Core
m_theory_core.current_text: Eleven dimensions, and all five string theories turn out to be one.
m_theory_core.research: M-Theory - Strings are the edges of membranes in eleven dimensions.

arrow_of_time_shard.name: Arrow of Time Shard
arrow_of_time_shard.current_text: Entropy only goes up - that is all "forward" means. This shard points the other way.
arrow_of_time_shard.research: Temporal Mechanics - The arrow of time, and how to tie it in knots without causing a paradox. Unlocks the Chrono Loom.

temporal_knot.name: Temporal Knot
temporal_knot.current_text: A worldline tied into a knot. Untie it and something happens twice.
temporal_knot.research: Temporal Mechanics - The arrow of time, and how to tie it in knots without causing a paradox. Unlocks the Chrono Loom.

novikov_crystal.name: Novikov Crystal
novikov_crystal.current_text: The self-consistency principle, crystallised: any time loop it is part of has no paradoxes.
novikov_crystal.research: Temporal Mechanics - The arrow of time, and how to tie it in knots without causing a paradox. Unlocks the Chrono Loom.

wave_packet.name: Wave Packet
wave_packet.current_text: A particle, written as a sum of waves - localised, but never exactly.
wave_packet.research: Quantum Field Theory - Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.

spinor_lattice.name: Spinor Lattice
spinor_lattice.current_text: Turn it through 360 degrees and it comes back negative. It takes 720 to restore it.
spinor_lattice.research: Quantum Field Theory - Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.

quantum_field_lattice.name: Quantum Field Lattice
quantum_field_lattice.current_text: Particles are only ripples. The field is what is real.
quantum_field_lattice.research: Quantum Field Theory - Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.

feynman_diagram.name: Feynman Diagram
feynman_diagram.current_text: Every possible history, summed. Each line is a particle, each vertex an interaction.
feynman_diagram.research: Quantum Field Theory - Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.

mathematics_singularity.name: Mathematics Singularity
mathematics_singularity.current_text: Every number, function, proof and infinity, compressed into one point.
mathematics_singularity.research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

standard_model_singularity.name: Standard Model Singularity
standard_model_singularity.current_text: Every particle that exists, compressed into one point.
standard_model_singularity.research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

spacetime_singularity.name: Spacetime Singularity
spacetime_singularity.current_text: All of relativity, compressed into the one place relativity breaks down.
spacetime_singularity.research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

stellar_singularity.name: Stellar Singularity
stellar_singularity.current_text: The whole life of a star, compressed into one point.
stellar_singularity.research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

dimensional_singularity.name: Dimensional Singularity
dimensional_singularity.current_text: All eleven dimensions, compressed into none.
dimensional_singularity.research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

temporal_singularity.name: Temporal Singularity
temporal_singularity.current_text: Every moment there has ever been, compressed into one instant.
temporal_singularity.research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

quantum_singularity.name: Quantum Singularity
quantum_singularity.current_text: Every possible state at once, compressed into one point.
quantum_singularity.research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

cognitive_singularity.name: Cognitive Singularity
cognitive_singularity.current_text: Every thought that could be thought, compressed into one point.
cognitive_singularity.research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

exotic_matter_singularity.name: Exotic Matter Singularity
exotic_matter_singularity.current_text: Negative mass, antimatter, strange matter and dark matter, compressed into one point.
exotic_matter_singularity.research: Conceptual Singularities - Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

theory_of_everything.name: Theory of Everything
theory_of_everything.current_text: Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model in one equation. It fits on a T-shirt.
theory_of_everything.research: Theory of Everything - Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model as one theory.

omniscience_catalyst.name: Omniscience Catalyst
omniscience_catalyst.current_text: All nine singularities, fused. Holding it, you know everything - briefly.

omnium_ingot.name: Omnium Ingot
omnium_ingot.current_text: A metal made of every concept there is. The last ingot.

platonic_compass.name: Platonic Compass
platonic_compass.current_text: Points at the realm of ideal forms - and, used, takes you there (and back).

iron_singularity.name: Iron Singularity
iron_singularity.current_text: 4,096 iron ingot, crushed into one point.

gold_singularity.name: Gold Singularity
gold_singularity.current_text: 4,096 gold ingot, crushed into one point.

copper_singularity.name: Copper Singularity
copper_singularity.current_text: 8,192 copper ingot, crushed into one point.

lapis_singularity.name: Lapis Singularity
lapis_singularity.current_text: 8,192 lapis lazuli, crushed into one point.

glowstone_singularity.name: Glowstone Singularity
glowstone_singularity.current_text: 8,192 glowstone dust, crushed into one point.

amethyst_singularity.name: Amethyst Singularity
amethyst_singularity.current_text: 4,096 amethyst shard, crushed into one point.

netherite_singularity.current_text: 512 netherite ingot, crushed into one point.

neutronium_singularity.current_text: 8,192 neutronium ingot, crushed into one point.

cherenkov_singularity.name: Cherenkov Singularity
cherenkov_singularity.current_text: 8,192 cherenkov quartz, crushed into one point.

void_lattice_singularity.name: Void Lattice Singularity
void_lattice_singularity.current_text: 8,192 void lattice shard, crushed into one point.

dilithium_singularity.name: Dilithium Singularity
dilithium_singularity.current_text: 4,096 dilithium crystal, crushed into one point.

chronosteel_singularity.current_text: 4,096 chronosteel ingot, crushed into one point.

stellar_iron_singularity.name: Stellar Iron Singularity
stellar_iron_singularity.current_text: 4,096 stellar iron ingot, crushed into one point.

prime_singularity.name: Prime Singularity
prime_singularity.current_text: 4,096 prime shard, crushed into one point.

kaluza_klein_singularity.name: Kaluza-Klein Singularity
kaluza_klein_singularity.current_text: 4,096 kaluza klein shard, crushed into one point.

tachyon_singularity.name: Tachyon Singularity
tachyon_singularity.current_text: 2,048 tachyon crystal, crushed into one point.

strange_matter_singularity.name: Strange Matter Singularity
strange_matter_singularity.current_text: 2,048 strange matter pellet, crushed into one point.

antimatter_singularity.name: Antimatter Singularity
antimatter_singularity.current_text: 2,048 antimatter pellet, crushed into one point.

exotic_crystal_singularity.name: Exotic Crystal Singularity
exotic_crystal_singularity.current_text: 2,048 exotic matter crystal, crushed into one point.

spacetime_alloy_singularity.name: Spacetime Alloy Singularity
spacetime_alloy_singularity.current_text: 2,048 spacetime alloy ingot, crushed into one point.

computronium_singularity.name: Computronium Singularity
computronium_singularity.current_text: 2,048 computronium ingot, crushed into one point.

cosmic_neutronium_singularity.name: Cosmic Neutronium Singularity
cosmic_neutronium_singularity.current_text: 1,024 cosmic neutronium ingot, crushed into one point.

cherenkov_lattice.name: Cherenkov Lattice
cherenkov_lattice.current_text: Diamond and Cherenkov quartz woven around netherite: a frame for a crystal that should not exist.

crystalline_matrix_ingot.name: Crystalline Matrix Ingot
crystalline_matrix_ingot.current_text: Lattices pinned in place by the light of two dead stars.
